def world_points(cam):
    d = np.asarray(cam.depth_m, float)
    K = np.array(cam.K, float); Tw = np.array(cam.camera_to_world, float)
    H,W = d.shape

def tube_masks(cam):
    rgb = np.asarray(cam.rgb, float)
    R,G,B = rgb[...,0],rgb[...,1],rgb[...,2]
    mx = rgb.max(-1); mn = rgb.min(-1)
    white = (mn>135) & (mx-mn < 34)
    orange = (R>150) & (R-B>70) & (G>70) & (G<200) & (B<140)
    return white, orange

def analyze(cam, uv0=None, rad_px=60, label=""):
    Pw, d = world_points(cam)
    white, orange = tube_masks(cam)
    H,W = d.shape

        yy,xx = np.mgrid[0:H,0:W]

    res = dict(cam=cam.name, n_white=int(white.sum()), n_orange=int(len(po)))
    if len(po):

        sign = np.sign((oc-c0) @ axis)
        if sign < 0: axis = -axis
        res["orange_center"]=oc.tolist()
    else:

    res["profile"]=prof

    return res

def cam_data(cam):

    H,W = d.shape

    P = np.stack([(uu-K[0,2])/K[0,0]*d, (vv-K[1,2])/K[1,1]*d, d], axis=-1)
    Pw = P @ Tw[:3,:3].T + Tw[:3,3]
    Pw[~np.isfinite(d)] = np.nan

    return dict(depth=d, K=K, Tw=Tw, Pw=Pw, rgb=rgb, H=H, W=W)

    R,G,B = rgb[...,0],rgb[...,1],rgb[...,2]
    mx = rgb.max(-1); mn = rgb.min(-1)
    white = (mn>135) & (mx-mn < 34)
    orange = (R>150) & (R-B>70) & (G>70) & (G<200) & (B<140)
    return white, orange

    D = cam_data(cam); Pw=D["Pw"]; rgb=D["rgb"]

    ok = np.isfinite(Pw).all(-1)
    white = white & ok
    lbl,n = ndimage.label(white)
    out=[]
    for i,sl in enumerate(ndimage.find_objects(lbl), start=1):
        m = lbl[sl]==i
        if m.sum()<min_px: continue
        pw = Pw[sl][m]; c0 = pw.mean(0)
        if not (zlo < c0[2] < zhi): continue
        U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(pw-c0, full_matrices=False)
        ax = Vt[0]; ax = ax/np.linalg.norm(ax)
        t = (pw-c0)@ax
        L = t.max()-t.min()
        if not (Lmin < L < Lmax): continue
        # width taper: pixel-space perpendicular spread along the tube
        vv,uu = np.nonzero(m)
        pts = np.c_[uu,vv].astype(float)
        pc = pts.mean(0)
        Up,Sp,Vtp = np.linalg.svd(pts-pc, full_matrices=False)
        d1 = Vtp[0]; d2 = Vtp[1]

    Jg = np.cross(ax, A_DOWN); Jg/=np.linalg.norm(Jg)
    Rg   = R_from_AJ(A_DOWN, Jg)
    Ryaw = R_from_AJ(A_DOWN, J_FIN)
    Rtilt= R_from_AJ(A_FWD,  J_FIN)
    p_link_grasp = grasp + np.array([0,0,pad])
    plan = {}
    plan["ax"]=ax; plan["tip"]=tip; plan["grasp"]=grasp
    plan["pregrasp"] = (p_link_grasp + np.array([0,0,0.09]), Rg)
    plan["grasp"]    = (p_link_grasp.copy(), Rg)
    lift = p_link_grasp + np.array([0,0,0.14])
    plan["lift"]     = (lift.copy(), Rg)
    plan["yaw"]      = (lift.copy(), Ryaw)

    """Find a white tube-like component; return geometry with mouth direction."""
    D = cam_data(cam); Pw=D["Pw"]; rgb=D["rgb"]
    white,orange = masks(rgb)
    ok = np.isfinite(Pw).all(-1)
    white = white & ok
    lbl,n = ndimage.label(white)
    cands=[]
    for i,sl in enumerate(ndimage.find_objects(lbl), start=1):

        # mid-extent (diameter) check: perpendicular spread
        perp = (pw-c0) - np.outer(t,ax)
        U2,S2,Vt2=np.linalg.svd(perp,full_matrices=False)
        diam = np.percentile(perp@Vt2[0],99)-np.percentile(perp@Vt2[0],1)

            if sel.sum()<8: return None
            v = rgb[sl][m][sel]
            return float(np.mean(v[:,0]-v[:,2]))

            ax = ax; mouth_col=cm; tip_col=ct
        elif cm is not None and ct is not None:
            ax = -ax; mouth_col=ct; tip_col=cm
        else:
            mouth_col=cm; tip_col=ct
        t2=(pw-c0)@ax
        cands.append(dict(c=c0, ax=ax, L=float(L), diam=float(diam),
                          tip=c0+ax*t2.min(), mouth=c0+ax*t2.max(),
                          mouth_col=mouth_col, tip_col=tip_col, n=int(m.sum())))
    if not cands: return None
    if near is not None:
        cands.sort(key=lambda d: np.linalg.norm(d["c"]-np.asarray(near)))
    return cands[0]

def measure_held(obs, arm, cam_name="head", rad=0.022, tspan=(-0.13,0.07)):

    if sel.sum()<40: return None
    tube_pts = pts[sel]
    tt = t[sel]
    # radial outliers (arm parts): keep within rad of the axis
    P = tube_pts - grasp
    T = P@Zl

               ax_pca=axp, c=c,

               n_orange=int((sel & orange[ok]).sum()) if orange_pts is not None else 0)

def measure_held_head(obs, arm, rad=0.024, tspan=(-0.14,0.09), cam_name="head", min_pts=120):
    """Measure the held tube from the head camera using the gripper axis as a filter."""
    p,R = tcp_axes(obs, arm)
    A = R[:,0]; Zl = R[:,2]
    grasp = p + PAD*A
    cam = obs.camera(cam_name)
    D = cam_data_cached(cam); Pw=D["Pw"]; rgb=D["rgb"]
    white, orange = masks(rgb)

    pts = Pw[ok]
    rel = pts - grasp
    t = rel@Zl
    perp = np.linalg.norm(rel - np.outer(t,Zl), axis=1)
    sel = (perp<rad) & (t>tspan[0]) & (t<tspan[1]) & white[ok]
    n=int(sel.sum())
    if n<min_pts: return None
    tp = pts[sel]; T=t[sel]
    dtip=float(np.percentile(T,2)); dmouth=float(np.percentile(T,98))
    tip = grasp + dtip*Zl
    # PCA axis
    c = tp.mean(0)
    U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(tp-c, full_matrices=False)
    ax = Vt[0]
    if ax@Zl < 0: ax = -ax
    tilt = float(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(ax@np.array([0.,0.,1.]),-1,1))))
    # orange collar near axis
    osel = (perp<rad) & (t>dmouth-0.005) & (t<tspan[1]+0.03) & orange[ok]
    oc = pts[osel].mean(0) if osel.sum()>20 else None
    return dict(grasp=grasp, A=A, Zl=Zl, tip=tip, dtip=dtip, dmouth=dmouth, n=n,
                ax=ax, c=c, tilt=tilt, orange_center=oc, n_orange=int(osel.sum()))

_CACHE={}
def cam_data_cached(cam):
    key=(cam.name, id(cam.rgb))
    return cam_data(cam)

def measure_axis_wrist(obs, arm, rad=0.022, tspan=(-0.05,0.095), bright=120, min_pts=120):

    else:
